So A = [yellow, magenta, red, cyan, green, blue].

Panel B: 3 columns, 2 rows.
Top row left to right: red, yellow, cyan.
Bottom row left to right: magenta, blue, green.

So B = [red, yellow, cyan, magenta, blue, green].

Let me double check panel B top row: first cell red, second yellow, third cyan (a bright cyan/turquoise). Bottom row: magenta, blue, green. Yes.

Return only JSON.
